model: Vacon NX OPT-CJ BACnet MS/TP option board
applies_to: Vacon NXS, NXP and NXL AC drives fitted with the OPT-CJ BACnet MS/TP option board (slot D or E).
summary: OPT-CJ adds BACnet MS/TP to Vacon NX drives (now Danfoss Drives). The object list is Binary Values for drive status, run/stop, direction and fault reset, and Analog Values for speed reference, frequency, current, power, energy, fault code, limits, ramps and raw fieldbus process data and control/status words.
firmware: Option board software OPTCJ_10522 (AV 34-39 from OPTCJ_10522V009)
default_device_instance: 0 = use the unique number read from the drive (shown in the monitor menu)
notes: Fieldbus must be the active control place on the drive for BV 15-17 and AV 24 to take effect.
AV 34-39 (AnyParam and the control/status words) were added in OPT-CJ software OPTCJ_10522V009.
AV 8, AV 13 and AV 14 are not available on NXL drives.
BV 7-14, BV 18-30 and the process data AVs are application specific; their meaning depends on the drive application.
C = commandable (priority array and relinquish default), per the manual.
Published by Danfoss on its documentation site; the manual is Vacon document DPD00901A.

integration.summary: Install the board in slot D or E, set MAC address, baud rate, instance number and communication time-out in menu M7, and make Fieldbus the active control place. Then command BV 15 run/stop and AV 24 speed reference, and read BV 1, AV 1 and the fault points.
integration.enable: Select Fieldbus as the active control place on the drive (see the Vacon NX user manual); BV 15 run/stop, BV 16 direction and AV 24 speed reference only work then.
integration.heartbeat: Parameter Comm. time-out (P7.x.1.4, 10-60 s in 10 s steps, default 10 s, 0 = off) raises a fieldbus fault if communication stops. The drive reaction is set by P2.7.22 Response to fieldbus fault: 0 no response, 1 warning, 2 fault with ramp stop, 3 fault with coast stop.
setup: Settings in keypad menu M7 for the board slot: P7.x.1.1 MAC address (1-127, default 1), P7.x.1.2 baud rate (0 auto, 9600 default, 19200, 38400, 76800).
P7.x.1.3 instance number: 0 (default) uses the unique number read from the drive; any other value becomes the device instance.
Monitor menu shows good/bad frame counters, actual baud rate, BACnet fault code and the instance number.
Bus termination with jumper X4 on the last device.
gotchas: Duplicate MAC addresses show as bad frames and BACnet fault code 2.
Commandable objects use the priority array; relinquish them to hand control back.
AV 0 is a read-only frequency setpoint; command speed through AV 24.

source.title: Vacon NX OPT-CJ BACnet Option Board User Manual
